Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BASIC HAND SPLINT, FOREARM PIECE 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensional and other requirements. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

FIG. I BASIC HAND SPLINT, FOREARM PIECE 



3. Material — Aluminium alloy conforming to Designation HS30WP of IS: 737-1965 * Specification for 
wrought aluminium ^nd aluminium alloys, sheet and strip (for general engineering purposes) (rev/sed)', 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The forearm piece shall be cut to size shown in Fig. I. It shall be reason- 
ably flat and the cut edges shall be straight. It shall be free from tool marks and surface defects. The cut 
edges shall be rounded by grinding or filing. The forearm piece shall be highly polished. The fmai shaping 
of the component shall be done at the time of fitting of the splint to the individual. 

5. Marking — Each piece shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials, or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) Size of the piece. 

5.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 18 September, 1972
